title: Muscle
description: A muscle or muscle group entry in the OEI muscle taxonomy

muscle_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for this muscle or muscle group.

entry_type.description: Whether this entry represents a muscle group (e.g. Quadriceps) or an individual muscle.

parent_group_id.description: The muscle_id of the parent muscle group for individual muscles. Null for top-level groups.

body_surface.description: Which body surface this muscle is primarily on.

laterality.description: Whether this muscle exists on both sides of the body.

description.description: Brief description of the muscle's location and primary function.

related_muscle_ids.description: IDs of anatomically or functionally related muscles.
